info.title: Flock Energy — Urja Meter Ops API
info.description:
A normalised, documented REST layer over the read-only **Urja Meter Ops** portal.

The service authenticates with the legacy portal on your behalf, signs and caches the bulk export, repairs messy hierarchy data, converts cumulative meter registers into interval consumption, and exposes stable JSON endpoints.

* Interactive docs: `/docs` (Swagger UI) or `/reference` (Scalar)
* Raw contract: `/openapi.json`
* Human dashboard: `/`

get.description: Returns the portal's readings with cumulative registers converted to typed values and per-interval deltas. Dates are inclusive and optional; omitting both uses the portal's 7-day default window. The portal mixes 30-minute and daily meters, so `granularity` is detected rather than assumed. Timestamps are interpreted as IST.

200.description: Readings in the portal's available window

get.description: Meters are organised Zone → Circle → Division → Subdivision → Substation → Feeder → DT. The portal reports per-meter paths, not a normalised tree; this endpoint merges blank codes/names, treats the DT registry as authoritative for names, and resolves nodes reported under multiple parents using the most frequent parent. Conflicts and data quality flags are included rather than hidden.
